about_the_game:
The essential kit to get you started in Battlefield 6. Stay a step ahead of the competition with a package of exclusive items designed for dropping in hot and opening fire.

Get the Season 1 Starter Pack and receive:
  • “Vanish Point” M277 Weapon Package
  • “Capped” Weapon Charm
  • “Tropical Storm” Dog Tag
  • 500 BFC
